metadata.title: RI1 metrics service
metadata.remarks: Minimal, hand-written component definition. It describes what this service exports; it is not a validated OSCAL document.

components.title: harmonia-metrics
components.description: Deterministic service computing baseline GitHub activity metrics and RI1 overlays for a repository.
components.purpose: Emit machine-readable evidence about repository activity, coherence, and the single most out-of-band organisational lever.

implemented-requirements.description: Exports event_count, event_type_counts, and weekly_activity from GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/events.
Exports harmonic_coherence_index, the ratio of code events to discussion events.
Exports recommended_lever, the single tunable parameter furthest outside its target band, selected from review_throughput, issue_closure_ratio, and discussion_density.
